'''Riyo Chuchi's office''' was an office used by [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]] during her tenure as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]].

==Description==
The office overlooked the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] skyline.

==History==
Senator Chuchi met with [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]] and his family there to discuss the developments of the [[Blockade of Pantora/Legends|Blockade of Pantora]].
